D. Alternatives to the Proposed Action.
The scientific merit of the proposed research has already been recognized and cannot be realized without occupying the site and undertaking project activities.
However, on certain project activities there are alternate solutions to those proposed. As described previously, solid wastes of the metallic and plastic categories and liquid wastes such as oils and lubricants will be returned to McMurdo Station for disposal. It is theoretically possible to expand this service for all liquid and solid wastes. Such an alternative is considered neither environmentally necessary nor economically feasible. Liquid and human solid waste will be disposed of in accordance with established practices developed for use on stations constructed over ice and snow. The return of domestic type waste waters and combustible nontoxic trash and garbage would merely add to environmental problems at McMurdo Station without a corresponding enhancement of the project site on the Ross Ice Shelf.
